data.name: King of the Exhibitions
data.detailed_description:
Step into the fast-paced world of automotive trade and build your empire from scratch in King of the Exhibitions!

Starting with a small, dusty lot and a handful of credits, you must buy low, sell high, and negotiate your way to the top. Scout classic relics, budget commuters, or exotic supercars from private sellers and high-stakes auctions. Restore damaged vehicles to increase their resale value or customize them to meet customer demands. Invest your profits back into your business: expand your floor space, decorate your showroom to attract wealthier clientele, hire skilled mechanics, and manage your reputation. Do you have the business acumen and automotive passion to become the ultimate showroom tycoon? Rule the market, outsmart the competition, and claim your title as the King of the Exhibitions!
